end.parentNote: Dev practised explaining how traditional choices can protect nature. They developed the idea that clay diyas break down into soil and do not leave plastic waste; this explanation was clarified and repeated later in the lesson. At home, ask Dev to give one example each of Bishnoi, sacred groves, and Chipko and explain how each helps nature.
